_doc: M1.5 G6: AI difficulty preset registry. cf-ai::DifficultyPreset::lookup(name) reads this file. Three presets: cakewalk (forgiving onboarding), tough_crowd (M1.5 default per DR-050), veteran (harder than tough_crowd, proves a loss path). Fields map 1:1 to ReactiveGuardParams (hp → max_hp; reload_ms → reload_seconds / 1000.0; etc). Adding presets is additive: cf-mod's validator accepts new entries as long as required fields are present.
